summary: Tested Records print/trash feature + unit_type + delete/edit propagation to saved receipts. Backend 12/12 pytest pass (new test_records_print_delete.py + updated test_quick_harvest_edit.py). Frontend (390px): Check-in Libra/Pieza toggle -> scans saved show '2 libra' / '3 pieza' in Records with date/time and Ganó; print button opens HTML ticket popup (Bluetooth fallback) with per-line unit labels and GANÓ total; trash -> confirm -> 'Escaneo borrado' toast and row removed; tapping row body opens edit dialog. One logic bug in the ticket total line when a worker has records in mixed units.

minor.issue: _resync_receipts(existing) runs only for the OLD date/worker. If an edit changes date or worker_id, saved receipts covering the new date/worker are not rebuilt. The UI never changes these fields today.

ui_bugs.issue: The Total line adds up units across mixed unit types and labels the sum with the clicked record's unit. Example: 2 libra + 3 pieza prints 'Total: 5 pieza'. Totals should be grouped per unit (e.g. '2 libra · 3 pieza').

issues: The unit toggle reads 'Pieza / libra / Horas'. 'libra' is lowercase, unlike the other two.
The mayordomo input next to the toggles is squeezed into a tiny white box at 390px width.

action_items: printWorkerTicket: group totalQty by unitOf(r) and print each unit's total (in both the thermal and HTML branches)
Optional: in update_harvest, also resync receipts for the new date/worker when they change
Optional: capitalize 'Libra' in the Asistencia toggle; fix the squeezed mayordomo input at 390px
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2300+ lines; split it into routers (harvests, receipts, attendance)
_resync_receipts runs one receipts() aggregation per matching snapshot on every edit/delete. Fine at this scale, but watch it as history grows.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_quick_harvest_edit.py (test_locked_by_receipt replaced with test_delete_covered_by_receipt_allowed, since the lock was intentionally removed)
seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_RPD workers/harvests and receipts_history records were deleted. Admin checkin-session restored to its original value (unitMode libra).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Export TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL/PASSWORD from backend/.env and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest. On /asistencia, click tile-check-in before the checkin-unit-{pieza|libra|horas} buttons are visible. Select employee suggestions with dispatch_event('mousedown'). Accept confirm() dialogs through page.on('dialog'). Print in headless Chromium falls back to a popup page (context.on('page')).
